hero.title: The financial terminal of the CEMAC markets
hero.lead: Follow BVMAC equities and the government securities of the six CEMAC countries, analyse companies and bonds, manage your portfolios and read independent research: one tool, in French and English.

preview.label: The CMarket terminal: indices, a price chart, top movers and a yield curve, with sample data.
preview.caption: Illustration · sample data

countries.label: CEMAC countries, with their government securities and yield curves

exchange.label: Equities and bonds of the regional exchange, in Douala

world.label: European and US markets, in the same screens

languages.label: The whole platform in French and English

features.title: Three uses in one tool, and a research marketplace
features.lead: Monitoring, analysis and portfolios share the same data, the same alerts and the same command bar: type a security and a function code, as on a terminal.

monitoring.title: Monitor the markets
monitoring.point1: Real-time prices, order book and latest trades
monitoring.point2: News, issuers' documents and the market calendar
monitoring.point3: Alerts on a price, a volume, an auction or a publication, in the app, by e-mail or by SMS

analysis.title: Analyse securities
analysis.point1: An equity screener on valuation, profitability, sector and country
analysis.point2: Financial statements and ratios over several years, against the sector
analysis.point3: The yield curves of the six countries and a bond calculator

portfolio.title: Manage portfolios
portfolio.point1: Positions valued at the day's prices, in XAF or EUR
portfolio.point2: Performance against a benchmark, risk and limits

research.title: Read and publish research
research.point1: Notes on a company or a country, free or paid
research.point2: The analysts you follow, and the record of their ratings
research.point3: Analysts publish with CMarket charts and are paid every month

markets.title: Central Africa first, and the world's markets
markets.lead: CMarket brings together the CEMAC data, loaded every day by its team, and the European and US markets.

cemac.title: CEMAC markets
cemac.text: The prices of the BVMAC and the government securities of the BEAC area, published every day from the official files once they are checked.
cemac.point1: BVMAC equities and bonds: prices, dividends, shareholders and documents
cemac.point2: Treasury bill and bond auctions (BTA, OTA) and the yield curves
cemac.point3: BEAC policy rates and exchange rates, the euro peg included

world.title: Europe and the United States
world.text: Equities, indices and currencies of the European and US markets through EODHD, in the same screens as the CEMAC securities.

markets.quality: Every file goes through format and business checks before it is published; a wrong price is corrected, and the correction recorded.

audience.title: One account type for each way of working
audience.lead: Each account type opens the screens and the quotas it needs; it is chosen at sign-up.

student.text: Delayed prices, simulated portfolios and research, on the student plan.

analyst.text: Historical data, ratios and exports; research to publish on a company or a country, free or paid.

manager.who: Asset and fund managers, insurers and pension funds
manager.cta: Sign up as a portfolio manager
manager.text: Portfolios valued and tracked, performance measured, and reports for your clients.

trader.who: Brokerage firms, banks and trading desks
trader.text: Real-time prices, the order book, intraday charts and alerts, and the government securities market.

audience.organization: An organisation account brings your colleagues together under one plan, paid by the organisation.

plans.title: A price per user, and 14 days free to start
plans.lead: Every account starts with 14 days of all the modules of its type. Then choose a plan, by month or by year.
plans.perMonth: per user per month, excl. VAT
plans.perYear: per user per year, excl. VAT
plans.payment: Pay by card, mobile money or bank transfer against an invoice. Prices exclude VAT ({{rate}}%).

independent.title: Independent
independent.text: CMarket routes no orders and holds no client funds: it provides data, analysis tools, portfolio tracking and research.

secure.title: Secure login
secure.text: A password and a one-time code by e-mail or SMS, and an automatic logout after a period of inactivity.

audited.title: Traceable
audited.text: Every file is checked before it is published, and every action of the back-office is written to an audit log.

closing.title: Try CMarket for 14 days
closing.text: Every module of your account type, free; then the plan of your choice.

footer.label: Links
footer.sources: Data: BVMAC and BEAC files; EODHD for Europe and the United States.
